mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.status AS task_status, t.create_time AS task_create_time, t.task_type, t.approver_id, t.stage_id, t.sub_workflow_approver_ids, i.id AS instance_id, i.business_type, i.business_id, i.applicant_id, w.id AS workflow_id, w.name AS workflow_name, u.real_name AS applicant_name, ma.id AS material_application_id, ma.title AS material_application_title, da.id AS deletion_application_id, da.title AS deletion_application_title, ua.id AS usage_apply_id, ua.title AS usage_apply_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset a WHERE a.application_id = ma.id AND a.deleted = 0) AS asset_count, (SELECT a.type FROM asset a WHERE a.application_id = ma.id AND a.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS asset_type FROM approval_task t INNER JOIN approval_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.id INNER JOIN workflow w ON i.workflow_id = w.id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON i.applicant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN material_application ma ON i.business_type = 'MATERIAL_ENTRY' AND i.business_id = ma.id AND ma.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN asset_deletion_application da ON i.business_type = 'ASSET_DELETION' AND i.business_id = da.id AND da.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN usage_apply ua ON i.business_type = 'ASSET_USAGE' AND i.business_id = ua.id AND ua.deleted = 0
t.approver_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'PENDING'
AND i.business_type = #{businessType}
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
